reason: Fixes the real bottleneck (protected review time, routing, backup), uses a clear measurable rule with anti-gaming checks and no individual scoring, and removes the reward with a keep/change/drop test, but the 8-hour clock is stricter than the one-day goal and the team-level reward plus 45 minutes a week of owner overhead may leave sceptical engineers unmoved, so the lasting effect depends on the workflow fixes sticking.
